tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Owner's palette, the lead hue. Fills: unlimited-plan bar, used visit segments, toast dot, trial chip outline, Ashtanga class marker. Not a text colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Owner's palette. Body text, the sidebar ground, the primary button and the plan tag. 11.5:1 on linen.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Owner's palette. The app ground behind every card.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Owner's palette. The Restorativna joga class marker. Use sparingly as a warm tint, never as a text colour.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Owner's palette. Terracotta means "look": unpaid items, health notes, full classes, attention buttons and error borders only. Never decorative. 3.6:1 on white, so use it for borders, dots and bars, not small text (use clay-text).

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, focused field border, ticked checkbox, selected sidebar item, capacity bar. White text on it reads 5.7:1.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on mist and mist-strong (active chip, neutral tag, flag tag). 7:1 on mist-strong.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Selected choice background, ghost button hover, empty visit segments, capacity bar track, light LangSwitch selection.

tokens.name: mist-strong
tokens.usage: Avatar fill, active status chip background, focus ring, text on the ink sidebar (10:1 on ink).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white and linen (6.1:1 on linen). Also the LangSwitch border on dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: overlines, table heads, hints, sublines. 5:1 on white but 4.36:1 on linen and 4.11:1 on header-row: below 4.5:1 there, kept as the source has it. Prefer it on white cards.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper terracotta for pressed or hovered attention fills.

tokens.name: clay-text
tokens.usage: Attention text: debts, error messages, the health-note heading. 7.4:1 on white, 5.4:1 on blush.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Attention ground: Notice, health tag, unpaid chip, error focus ring.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row hover and read-only field ground.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists; read-only field border.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Control border at rest (inputs, secondary buttons, unticked checkbox). 1.5:1 on white: below the 3:1 border floor, kept as the source has it; the label above carries the field.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: The one added hue, used only for "expiring": chip and renewal badge ground.

tokens.name: stone-dot
tokens.usage: Frozen chip dot and placeholder text.

tokens.name: class-spine
tokens.usage: Class marker: Joga za kralježnicu. Used as a 10×22px pill in schedule tables.

tokens.name: surface-readonly
tokens.usage: Read-only inputs and the signature box.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text on linen, white and mist.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white and linen.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on white (4.98:1); on linen and header-row it is below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text-attention
tokens.usage: Attention text on white and blush.

tokens.name: status-trial-bg
tokens.usage: Status chip ground: Proba (dashed sage outline, no dot).

tokens.name: status-trial-fg
tokens.usage: Status chip text: Proba (dashed sage outline, no dot).

tokens.name: status-trial-dot
tokens.usage: Status chip dot: Proba (dashed sage outline, no dot).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page titles in PageHeader. The only page-scale use of the brand serif.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells and inputs.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Kad prodate prvu kartu, ovdje će se pojaviti račun.
styles.usage: Helper copy, form explanations and checkbox labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase card overlines (0.2em). Table heads use the same style at 0.16em.

styles.name: signature
styles.usage: Only the signature line on the upisnica.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table row padding; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row side padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, choices, notices, toasts.

shadow.note: Cards have no shadow; separate them with the line hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: toasts, menus, modals.
